g.title: Backend requests a shared MongoDB client.
MONGODB_URI environment lookup, pool of 10 and six-second selection timeout. No URI is displayed.
Live services fail without MongoDB. A legacy local adapter exists after an unconditional early rejection and is not a working fallback.
Configured DB name or ovia default; deployed Atlas topology is Unverified.
setupDatabase defines identity, email uniqueness, token TTL and checkout idempotency indexes.
Repository reads and transactional writes return stored records.
Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.
Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.
